_comment: The current Gauntlet round. This is the only file that changes between rounds.
_window_comment: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD bounds, Eastern. Must match the Custom range you set on the dashboard's Leaderboard tab.
_prizes_comment: Keys are a rank ('7') or an inclusive range ('10-20'). 'pool' is a checksum: the build aborts if the ladder does not sum to it. These values mirror PRIZE_TABLE in the dashboard's frontend/utils/format.ts, so change both together.
_affiliate_comment: An affiliate is a user whose id owns a Promotion. Excluded, so they neither rank nor are owed a prize. On the dashboard this is the Affiliates toggle, which defaults to All and must be set to Exclude before exporting by hand.
_final_comment: Set true for the closing update of a round. Changes the hero line to 'Final Standings as of'.
